primary_title: Multiple effector coupling of somatostatin receptor subtype SSTR1

primary_title: Functional coupling of SSTR4, a major hippocampal somatostatin receptor, to adenylate cyclase inhibition, arachidonate release and activation of the mitogen-activated protein kinase cascade
primary_validation_summary: SSTR4 PTX-sensitive Gi-linked adenylyl-cyclase inhibition and MAPK-associated function are supported in rat receptor-expressing CHO cells.
